_doc: The map's tiles drawn by FLUX over OpenRouter (tools/tiles/gen_tiles.py): a ground is a seamless texture under the dual grid of MapField, a prop a thing on a square cut out of its frame. The ids are the ones of `grounds` in game/data/layouts.json.

style.ground: Seamless tileable texture, straight top-down orthographic view looking directly down at the ground, {subject}. Hand-painted fantasy RPG battle map texture, painterly brushwork like a painted tabletop map, muted natural colours, soft even diffuse light, flat, no perspective, no horizon, no objects standing out, no border, no frame, no text, the same density of detail across the whole image.
style.prop: Straight top-down orthographic view from directly above of {subject}, one single object centred in the frame with empty space around it. Hand-painted fantasy RPG battle map token art, painterly brushwork, muted natural colours, soft light from the upper left, isolated on a plain flat light grey background, no ground texture, no text, no border.
style.edge: Repaint this colour map as one seamless hand-painted fantasy RPG battle map texture seen straight from above. The green areas are {high}; the blue areas are {low}. Where they meet, {meet}. Keep the exact shape and position of the green and blue areas, the same colours and the same light over the whole picture; painterly brushwork, muted natural colours, soft even light, no perspective, no horizon, no border, no frame, no grid lines, no text.

ground.grass: a meadow of short green grass with a few clover leaves and tiny wildflowers
ground.dirt: packed brown earth of a footpath with small pebbles and dry patches
ground.cobble: an old road paved with rounded grey cobblestones and earth between them
ground.water: clear shallow river water, blue green, gentle ripples, a few pebbles visible on the bottom
ground.mud: wet dark mud with brambles, roots and puddles
ground.planks: a floor of old wooden planks laid in straight rows, warm brown, worn and scuffed
ground.cave: the rough grey stone floor of a cave with cracks and grit
ground.pit: a deep dark chasm, nearly black with faint rough rock
ground.wall: the top of a thick rough stone masonry wall, grey stones of different sizes with mortar
ground.roof: a roof of dark brown wooden shingles laid in overlapping straight rows, weathered, with a little moss
ground.rock: the rough natural rock of a cave wall seen from above, dark grey and brown stone with jagged cracks, ledges and grit, solid and impassable
ground.still_water: dark still stagnant water of a cave pool or a swamp, murky green brown, almost black in the depths, a little scum and a few floating leaves, no ripples
ground.sand: fine pale golden sand of a dry desert or a beach, soft wind ripples and a few tiny pebbles
ground.thorns: dry desert sand overgrown with low thorny scrub, dead twigs and dry grey brown bushes with spines
ground.snow: fresh white snow on the ground, soft drifts and faint blue shadows, a few small footprints-free hollows
ground.ice: a frozen crust of bluish white ice and hard packed snow, cracked plates and frosty streaks
ground.stony: rocky mountain ground, grey gravel and small flat stones with thin patches of dry soil
ground.scree: loose scree, a slope of broken sharp grey rocks and stones of different sizes
ground.tall_grass: tall dense wild grass and weeds, green and straw yellow blades, unmowed meadow
ground.farmland: a ploughed field, straight parallel furrows of dark brown earth with a few green sprouts
ground.reeds: a dense bed of reeds and cattails in shallow murky marsh water, green and brown stalks
ground.flagstone: a floor of large square grey stone flagstones laid in straight rows, worn smooth, thin dark joints

props.tree: the round leafy crown of a broad deciduous oak tree, dense green foliage
props.boulder: a large mossy grey boulder seen exactly from straight above like a satellite photo: only its rounded top is visible, no sides, no perspective
props.table: a rectangular wooden tavern table seen exactly from straight above like a floor plan: only the flat tabletop of planks is visible with two clay mugs and a candle on it, no legs, no sides, no perspective
props.door: a closed rectangular wooden door made of vertical planks with iron bands, lying flat
props.rubble: a heap of broken stone rubble and fallen masonry blocks from a ruined wall, grey stones of different sizes

edges.*: a natural meeting of the two with a soft uneven border
edges.water__grass: a natural grassy river bank with a thin line of wet earth and a little foam
edges.water__dirt: a muddy shore of packed earth with a thin wet dark line and a little foam
edges.water__mud: a boggy marsh edge with reeds, wet roots and a little scum on the water
